acceptance.given: The published policy and schemas, the reference package, the normative standard, and the declared migration test are available in the repository.

oracle.expected: The migration acceptance test invokes the real validator against the published policy and schemas and reference package, verifies the structured passing result, and records an external review check for the normative standard.
forbidden: Validation uses unpublished or unused policy or schemas.
The reference package is not checked against the actual published policy and schemas.
The normative standard has no external review check.
oracle.observable: A structured pytest result from the declared migration selector showing validator output tied to the published policy and schemas, reference-package validation, and the normative-standard review artifact/check.

acceptance.then: The clean-validation and external-review evidence is produced by the real migration test and identifies the published policy, schemas, reference package, and normative standard.
acceptance.when: During the migration acceptance test, execute the real validator/CLI and inspect its structured result and the normative-standard review check.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a22_clean_package_validation_and_standard_review must fail with an AssertionError when the validator does not validate the published policy/schemas and reference package or when the normative-standard external review check is absent.

affected_subjects: Clean package validation and standard review
Package A migration compatibility and terminal acceptance
slice_hint.behavior_change: Add the published skill-authoring standard, policy and schemas, validator entrypoint, ADR/index record, and migration acceptance coverage proving clean validation against the published artifacts and external review of the normative standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime state migration; remove or revert only the newly published standard, policy, schemas, validator, and ADR/index entry while preserving existing skill-contract and skill-input protocols.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unpublished or unverified standard artifacts become published, validator-consumed artifacts with migration evidence linking the reference package and external review check.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The declared migration selector passes while proving the reference package passes against the published policy/schemas, a mutated package is rejected, and the normative standard review check is present.
